skills.detail: Deals a close-range attack while the skill button is held down. Reduces chance of getting pushed away when attacked by enemy while the skill is active. Deals a close-range attack with a Knockback effect after a certain amount of time has passed or when the skill button is released. You are able to move while holding down the skill button. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Iron Body: Wheel

skills.detail:
Begin charging by holding down the skill button. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time. There is a cooldown in effect for a set period of time at the start of battle.

When the enemy has a Treasure Area:
If you let go of the skill button before the charge has completed, the charge will cancel and you will travel to the nearest Treasure Area. If the charge has finished, you will travel to the furthest enemy Treasure Area.

Not Charged:
Moves you to the nearest enemy Treasure Area.

Charged:
Moves you to the furthest enemy Treasure Area.

When the enemy has no Treasure Area:
After a certain amount of time has passed or when the skill button is released, the charge will cancel and your DEF will increase.
